AC Law Firm Circosta operates with an international outlook, supporting companies, institutions and individuals in the complex field of international and global law.

Contracts, Disputes and Arbitration

We assist in cross-border contracts, international disputes and arbitration, providing legal advice that bridges multiple jurisdictions and takes account of geopolitical dynamics.

Protection of Human Rights

We are also strongly committed to the protection of human rights, defending fundamental freedoms and human dignity before national courts and supranational tribunals.

With our presence on several continents, we deliver coordinated strategies that combine legal expertise with a deep understanding of international markets.
